author: Keymonte Avery
title: Baton Rouge man arrested, faces drug and gun charges after traffic stop - NewsBreak
text:
By Keymonte Avery ,
6 hours ago
BATON ROUGE, La. (Louisiana First) — The Louisiana State Police arrested a man accused of driving while intoxicated on Tuesday night.
State Police said shortly before midnight, troopers saw a 2021 Dodge Charger traveling at 147 miles per hour on I-10 near Essen Lane. Troopers initiated a traffic stop. During the stop, troopers saw signs of impairment and reported an odor of marijuana coming from the vehicle. State troopers initiated a DWI investigation and searched the vehicle. The driver was identified as Kevin Camacho, 20, of Baton Rouge.
During the search, troopers found a loaded gun, a digital scale, about 80 grams of marijuana, THC vape products, and packing materials.
Camacho was arrested and booked into the East Baton Rouge Prison on charges of driving while intoxicated, possession with the intent to distribute marijuana, possession of a firearm in the presence of a controlled dangerous substance, and possession of drug paraphernalia.
This is an ongoing investigation.
